findings.finding_text: Unparseable evidence JSON is silently skipped by the drift alarm — parse failure yields parsed:undefined, findStampedRevs returns [], file treated as unstamped; the one module whose job is failing loud goes quietly green on corrupt records.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Real silent-green defect (blind HIGH + edge MED + auditor LOW merged); fix: push 'unreadable evidence file' failure in the catch.

findings.finding_text: writeEvidence spread corrupts non-object payloads (array becomes char-indexed object) and silently overwrites a caller-supplied swarmclawForkRev stamp.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Guard: stamp only plain objects, throw otherwise; throw on caller-supplied stamp key (never launder a recorded rev).

findings.finding_text: validateEvidenceForkRevs never validates pinnedAt — a non-ISO-Z caller value shifts every bracket via lexicographic compare.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Validate ISO_Z(pinnedAt) + real instant at entry, fail loud.

findings.finding_text: citing.timestamp passes shape check but may be a semantically impossible instant (2026-13-45T99:99:99Z) that brackets deterministically by string accident.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Add Date.parse NaN check alongside ISO_Z.

findings.finding_text: manifest.rounds absent or non-array silently coerces to [] — coverage verdicts replace the malformed-manifest verdict, contradicting the 'shape is asserted' comment.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Push malformed-rounds failure when rounds key exists but is not an array; also when manifest parses but has no rounds key.

findings.finding_text: Unreadable manifest pushes one failure then continues with rows=[] — N+1 spam misattributing the root cause as per-file coverage misses.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Early-return the unreadable-manifest failure.

findings.finding_text: Pre-pin manifest row missing rev produces 'expected=undefined' — garbage report where the module promises actionable drift lines.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Malformed-row check (missing rev) before comparison; failure names the row.

findings.finding_text: Duplicate manifest rows for the same file pass silently — find() reads only the first, a contradictory second row is never seen.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Detect duplicate row files, fail by name.

findings.finding_text: Alarm checks files→rows only; manifest rows naming nonexistent files (typo, deleted evidence, or a CI clone lacking untracked evidence JSONs) rot silently. Concretely: 6 stamped-row sc2-7 evidence files are untracked on this branch — a clean CI checkout would fail coverage while a dirty local tree stays green.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add rows→files direction check; driver commits the 6 untracked sc2-7 evidence JSONs with the branch so CI clone coverage is real.

findings.finding_text: Row matching keys by basename while walkJsons recurses subdirs — same-named files in different round subdirs collide, nested rows never match, and the 'round subdirs allowed tomorrow' comment promises what the mapping cannot do.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Key walk results by path relative to the stamped dir; match rows on that relative path only; align comment.

findings.finding_text: A missing stamped dir (typo in STAMPED_EVIDENCE_DIRS, renamed evidence dir) is readdir-catch-continued into silent inertness — alarm permanently green with ok:true.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: If evidenceDir itself is absent throw (misconfigured invocation); a missing stamped subdir under an existing evidenceDir is a failure.

findings.finding_text: AC7's negative control is unrealized: nothing fails if writeEvidence stops stamping — the stamp has no enforcing test, so a harness refactor re-arms the exact silent-green failure AC7 names.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Add a source-level stamp-presence test in swarmclaw-fork-pin.test.ts (asserts sc2-harness writeEvidence body carries the stamp + pin import) — mutation-free, fails if the stamp is dropped.

findings.finding_text: Pin↔manifest coherence (meta.pinRev/pinnedAt === exports) is test-only; the validator never reads meta, and no test ties the pin to the newest round row's rev (AC4's equality target).
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Validator requires meta.pinRev === pin and meta.pinnedAt === pinnedAt; alarm suite adds real-manifest newest-row-rev === pin assertion; fixtures gain meta.

findings.finding_text: AC3's box-free/lock-free purity is asserted in prose only — result probes run with a working FakeDriver and ledger, so a future driver touch in buildResult stays green.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add poisoned-deps probe: throwing driver proxy + throwing ledgerFactory, expect exit 0 + payload anyway.

findings.finding_text: AC2's 'closed' state vocabulary is open on the real wire (src/fleet/status.ts (string & {}) fail-visible passthrough) — the second schema debt is recorded nowhere.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: src/ is untouchable (box COPY set); record the debt in the helper docblock: consumers must tolerate fail-visible unknown state words per the module's own design.

findings.finding_text: expectExactFields exists twice and its refusal mechanism (missing AND extra fail by name) is tested nowhere — a future edit to either copy breaks the suite's core discipline silently.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Export the helper's copy; add one meta-test in the q1 extension feeding fat + short payloads and asserting named-field throws.

findings.finding_text: Closure test name overclaims: 'allows exactly status and result' is backed only by an existence assertion, not a closure proof.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Reword the test name to what is proven (registry contains both rows; result driver-free; status wrapper-driven; other verbs outside this contract per INV-Z1-2).

findings.finding_text: Fixture binds STAMPED_EVIDENCE_DIRS[0] — reordering the export silently retargets every fixture.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Authorship test asserts STAMPED_EVIDENCE_DIRS toEqual ['openrig-sc2'] so reorder fails loud.

findings.finding_text: Production wiring under-exercised: all failure-mode fixtures stage the manifest outside evidenceDir; the production layout (manifest inside the walked dir) executes only via the vacuous-true real-corpus test.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Add one drift fixture in the exact production layout (manifest inside the stamped dir, basename row lookup).

findings.finding_text: Uppercase .JSON files are not walked; a fork-rev-manifest.json in a SUBDIR is excluded by basename even as evidence.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Case-insensitive extension check; scope the manifest-name exclusion to the top level of the stamped dir.

findings.finding_text: A swarmclawForkRev key with a non-string value is neither collected nor flagged — a differently-shaped stamp escapes the alarm.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Track non-string stamp keys and fail loud ('stamp must be a string').

findings.finding_text: Two writeEvidence calls in the same millisecond with same tag+name silently truncate the first (no wx flag).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: writeFileSync flag 'wx' — silent loss becomes loud error; adds-only, one line.

findings.finding_text: Every new stamped evidence round fails CI until a hand-authored manifest row lands — alarm fatigue by design, no tooling shipped.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Story-mandated: AC6 names the coverage finding ('add its rev from round provenance — never guess'); DD-29 records the no-adopter-script decision and its revisit trigger. Tooling would contradict Technical Notes.

findings.finding_text: DD-29 prose vs import graph: harness imports the scripts/-root pin module the spec declares outside the box COPY set.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: No contradiction: tests/ is also outside the box COPY set; the factory repo consumes its own module; INV-Z1-1 bars fork imports, not factory-internal ones.

findings.finding_text: sc2-1-5 manifest row citing timestamp is a midnight placeholder (2026-09-28T00:00:00Z).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Honest floor bracket for a date-only round; meta.sourceRule documents timeline-bracketed inference; changing the value adds no truth.

findings.finding_text: Shared store + duplicate store.create of identical runIds across q1 observe tests — order-dependent and possibly throwing (O_EXCL).
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Misread verified against source: store is the beforeEach-fresh file-scope let (new tmpdir store per test), one create per id per store; RunRecordStore.create O_EXCL never re-triggered; suites green 14/0 and 68/0.

findings.finding_text: Tests 1/2 and 3/4 are identical invocations wearing different names — duplicated store mutations and runtime.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: By design: one helper sweep per verb, four named properties (AC1 running, AC1 exit-4, AC2 status pins, AC3/AC8 closure) asserted per sweep; with F-026's premise gone there is no correctness cost and 1.8s total runtime.
